title: Pepper roast chicken with broccoli
summary: Skinless chicken breast roasted hard with black pepper, garlic and lemon, with broccoli and crisp celery on the side. A light British plate that is mostly protein.

steps.instruction: Heat the fan oven to 200°C. Pat the chicken dry and rub it with the oil, garlic, lemon juice, pepper and salt. Lay it in the tin.
steps.tip: Coarse pepper is the point of this one. Fine pepper just disappears.

steps.instruction: Roast the chicken for 10 minutes, then tuck the broccoli around it and roast until the chicken is opaque in the middle and the broccoli is charred at the edges.
Rest the chicken for a few minutes while you cut the celery into sticks. The rest keeps the meat juicy.
steps.tip: If the broccoli is already tender, take it out and let the chicken finish alone.

steps.instruction: Slice the chicken, spoon over the tin juices and serve with the broccoli and celery. No potatoes on this plate, so the calories stay low.

image.alt: Peppered roast chicken breast with broccoli and celery sticks on a patterned plate
